description: Fix all 35 audit issues across backend, edge, and frontend. This is a single large feature because all fixes are independent code changes that can be batched.
steps: ISSUE 1 (CRITICAL): In apps/backend/app/api/v1/payments.py, the synchronous razorpay.Client calls at lines 47-48 (create_order), 128-130 (credit-topup), and 184-186 (credit-topup/verify: client.order.fetch) block the async event loop. Wrap all `client.order.create(...)` and `client.order.fetch(...)` calls in `await asyncio.to_thread(...)`. Add `import asyncio` at the top if not already present.
ISSUE 2 (HIGH): In apps/backend/app/models/user.py, add `credits_remaining: int = 0` field to the User model class, in the Usage section after `total_lifetime_messages`.

ISSUE 3 (HIGH): In apps/backend/app/services/search/vertex_search.py, the init check at line 44 requires GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON which is not available on Cloud Run with Workload Identity. Change the condition to: `if settings.VERTEX_PROJECT_ID and settings.VERTEX_SEARCH_DATASTORE_ID and (settings.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON or settings.GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS or os.environ.get('K_SERVICE'))`. Also update `_init_client` to handle ADC: if `settings.google_credentials` returns empty dict AND K_SERVICE is set, use google.auth.default() instead of from_service_account_info. Import `os` at top.

ISSUE 4 (HIGH): In apps/backend/app/api/v1/health.py, the basic health check at @router.get('') currently returns 200 with 'degraded' status when startup_errors is non-empty. Change it to return a 503 status code using JSONResponse when startup_errors is non-empty.

ISSUE 5 (HIGH): In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, the webhook looks up users by `razorpay_subscription_id`. But in payments.py verify endpoint (line 89), it stores `body.razorpay_order_id` in the `razorpay_subscription_id` field. The webhook handler should also try to find users by order_id. After the `User.find_one({'razorpay_subscription_id': sub_id})` returns None in the subscription.charged handler, add a fallback lookup: also search with the `payment.order_id` from the payload if available. Also add a regex for order IDs `^order_[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` and handle both prefixes (sub_ and order_) in the webhook.

ISSUE 6 (HIGH): In apps/edge/src/routes/api-proxy.ts, line ~35 deletes Content-Length from the REQUEST headers being forwarded. This breaks POST/PUT requests with bodies. Remove `headers.delete('Content-Length')` from the request header section (keep only the delete in the stream response section at line ~118 which correctly removes it from response headers for chunked streaming).

ISSUE 7 (HIGH): In apps/frontend/src/pages/ChatPage.jsx line 60, the default model state is 'openai/gpt-oss-20b'. The ModelSelector.jsx MODELS array uses 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' which maps to 'Syrabit SLM'. The backend router only recognizes 'sarvam'/'gemini'/'vertex' model names. The model value sent to backend is actually ignored for routing (backend uses language detection). Update the default model in ChatPage.jsx to 'gemini-2.5-flash' and update the MODELS array in ModelSelector.jsx to use value 'gemini-2.5-flash' for the first entry (keeping the same label 'Syrabit SLM').

ISSUE 8 (HIGH): In apps/edge/src/middleware/jwt.ts, the PUBLIC_PATHS array includes '/api/v1/content' which skips JWT for ALL content paths. Narrow it to '/api/v1/content/public' to only skip JWT for the explicitly public content sub-routes. Also add '/api/v1/content/boards', '/api/v1/content/classes', '/api/v1/content/streams', '/api/v1/content/subjects', '/api/v1/content/chapters', '/api/v1/content/chunks', '/api/v1/content/chapter-by-slug', '/api/v1/content/topic' to the public paths list since these are read-only content endpoints used without auth.

ISSUE 9 (HIGH): In apps/backend/app/api/v1/health.py, the vertex_ping() function reports unhealthy when GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS_JSON is missing. On Cloud Run with Workload Identity, ADC (Application Default Credentials) is used instead. Add a check: if `os.environ.get('K_SERVICE')` is set (indicating Cloud Run), report healthy even without explicit credentials JSON. Import `os` at top of file.

ISSUE 10 (MEDIUM): Double CORS header application. In apps/edge/src/index.ts around line 176 for API routes, the code calls `applyCorsHeaders(secured.headers, origin)` AFTER the proxy already sets CORS headers in api-proxy.ts (lines 107-109). Remove the CORS header lines from api-proxy.ts (lines 107-109 where it sets Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials on the responseHeaders) since the main handler in index.ts applies them via applyCorsHeaders.

ISSUE 11 (MEDIUM): In .env.shared, the model values are mismatched with config.py defaults. config.py has VERTEX_GEMINI_MODEL='gemini-2.5-flash' and SARVAM_MODEL='sarvam-m', but .env.shared has VERTEX_GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.0-flash-lite and SARVAM_MODEL=openhathi-7b. Update .env.shared to match: VERTEX_GEMINI_MODEL=gemini-2.5-flash and SARVAM_MODEL=sarvam-m. Also update CF_AI_MODEL from @cf/meta/llama-3.1-70b-instruct to @cf/meta/llama-3.1-8b-instruct to match config.py default.

ISSUE 12 (MEDIUM): In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py, the _get_signing_key and _get_verification_key functions handle RS256/HS256 fallback. Add a health check warning in the basic health endpoint when algorithm mismatch is detected. In apps/backend/app/api/v1/health.py, add a check in the basic health check that detects when JWT_ALGORITHM is RS256 but JWT_PRIVATE_KEY or JWT_PUBLIC_KEY is not set, and include this as a warning in the response.

ISSUE 13 (MEDIUM): In apps/frontend/src/hooks/useTokenManager.js, tokens are stored in sessionStorage which is lost when the tab closes. Change refresh token storage to use localStorage (more persistent) while keeping access tokens in memory only (not in any storage for security). Update safeSessionSet/Get/Remove to use localStorage for the refresh token key specifically.

ISSUE 14 (MEDIUM): In apps/frontend/src/utils/api.jsx line 4, when VITE_BACKEND_URL is not set, API_BASE defaults to '/api/v1' (empty string prefix). Add a console.error warning when the env var is not set. In production builds (import.meta.env.PROD), throw an error to prevent silent failures.

ISSUE 15 (MEDIUM): queryClient is already properly extracted to apps/frontend/src/queryClient.js and imported in App.jsx. The re-export from App.jsx exists for backward compatibility. Add a comment in App.jsx explaining this is intentional. This also covers Issue 35.

ISSUE 16 (MEDIUM): In apps/edge/src/middleware/rate-limit.ts, the read-then-write race condition already has a comment at lines 50-53 explaining the trade-off. The existing comment is adequate. Verify and if needed, enhance the documentation comment to be more explicit about the Durable Objects alternative.

ISSUE 17 (MEDIUM): In apps/edge/src/index.ts, the health check code at lines 127-150 uses env.ISR_CACHE_KV without checking if it is bound. Add an explicit null check: `if (env.ISR_CACHE_KV)` before the KV operations in the health endpoint, and fall back to direct backend fetch if KV is not available.

ISSUE 18 (MEDIUM): In apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py, add a TTL index on the `chats` collection using `created_at` field with expireAfterSeconds set to 90 days (90 * 24 * 60 * 60 = 7776000). Add this in the create_indexes() function.

ISSUE 19 (MEDIUM): In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py around line 185, the token blacklist check fails open (passes through on Redis error). For payment/subscription endpoints, this is unsafe. Add a fail-closed check: when the request path contains '/payments/' or '/credit-topup', raise HTTPException(503) if Redis is unavailable for the blacklist check.

ISSUE 20 (MEDIUM): In apps/backend/app/services/ai/router.py line 26, the detect_language function requires assamese_chars >= 10 which means very short Assamese queries (under 10 chars) are misrouted to English. Lower the threshold from 10 to 3 characters, so even short Assamese words are correctly detected.

ISSUE 21 (MEDIUM): In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py, the _make_cache_hash method only uses message and lang for the cache key, ignoring user_tier. This means free and pro users get the same cached responses despite potentially different RAG results. Add user_tier to the cache input: change `cache_input = f'{sanitized_message}:{lang}'` to `cache_input = f'{sanitized_message}:{lang}:{user_tier}'` and update the method signature to accept user_tier parameter.

ISSUE 22 (MEDIUM): In apps/backend/app/api/v1/payments.py, after signature verification in the /verify endpoint (~line 85), add validation that compares the stored amount in Redis against expected plan prices. After retrieving stored_amount from Redis, verify it matches the expected plan price before upgrading the user. If mismatch, log warning and reject.

ISSUE 23 (MEDIUM): In apps/frontend/src/entry-server.jsx, add comprehensive documentation comments explaining the SSR architecture: how prerendering works, the relationship between entry-server.jsx and the prerender scripts, how React Query state is hydrated, and how globalThis SSR preloads work.

ISSUE 24 (MEDIUM): In apps/edge/src/index.ts around line 199, the root path '/' goes through the generic redirect logic which redirects to frontend origin + '/'. Add a specific handler for url.pathname === '/' that redirects directly to '/library' before the generic CF Cache block.

ISSUE 25 (MEDIUM): In apps/backend/app/api/deps/rate_limit.py, the architecture documentation is already present at the top of the file. Verify the existing comment is clear. Add additional inline documentation explaining that this is NOT a bug - the edge and backend rate limits serve different purposes (burst vs quota).

ISSUE 26 (MEDIUM): In apps/backend/app/api/v1/chat.py, the streaming endpoint has no global timeout. Add a maximum stream duration timeout of 60 seconds around the event_stream() generator. Use asyncio.wait_for or implement a heartbeat mechanism that sends a keep-alive SSE comment every 15 seconds and aborts after 60 seconds total.

ISSUE 27 (LOW): In apps/backend/app/core/rate_limiter.py, add a DeprecationWarning that fires on module import (not just on class instantiation). The class already has warnings. Add a module-level warning at the top after imports.
ISSUE 28 (LOW): Add a README.md note in the root-level /frontend/ directory documenting that it is a legacy directory retained for reference only, and that the active frontend is at /apps/frontend/.

ISSUE 29 (LOW): In apps/edge/src/index.ts, the CF Cache API section (lines 194-207) caches 302 redirect responses. Add a condition to skip caching when the response is a redirect (status 302). Only cache the response if it would be a non-redirect.
ISSUE 30 (LOW): In apps/backend/app/db/mongo.py, add an index on the `topic_embeddings` collection's `topic_id` field in the create_indexes() function.

ISSUE 31 (LOW): In apps/backend/app/config.py, the validate_production_secrets method logs an error when ADMIN_JWT_SECRET matches JWT_PRIVATE_KEY but does not prevent startup. For production, when ADMIN_JWT_SECRET equals JWT_SECRET (not JWT_PRIVATE_KEY), it should also be a hard error. Add: if ADMIN_JWT_SECRET == JWT_SECRET in production, add to startup_errors.

ISSUE 32 (LOW): In apps/backend/app/services/ai/vertex_client.py, the stream methods call vertex_circuit_breaker._on_success() and ._on_failure() directly (private methods). Change these to use the public methods: vertex_circuit_breaker.record_success() and vertex_circuit_breaker.record_failure().

ISSUE 33 (LOW): In apps/backend/app/services/chat_service.py, the save_chat method's final except block calls store_dead_letter but does not log the actual message payload that was lost. Add a final fallback log line that logs the user_message content (truncated) so ops can manually recover.

ISSUE 34 (LOW): In apps/backend/app/core/security.py, add newer prompt injection patterns to the injection_patterns list: DAN variants, jailbreak patterns, markdown/HTML injection attempts. Add patterns like: 'Do Anything Now', 'DAN mode', 'jailbreak', 'developer mode', '<script', 'javascript:', 'onerror=', 'onload=', 'Act as if you', 'Pretend you are', 'From now on you'.
ISSUE 35 (LOW): Already covered by Issue 15 (queryClient re-export). No additional work needed.
acceptance_criteria: All modified Python files pass `python -m py_compile` without errors
All modified TypeScript files pass basic syntax check
The synchronous Razorpay SDK calls are wrapped in asyncio.to_thread()
The User model has a credits_remaining field
Health endpoint returns 503 when startup_errors is non-empty
Content-Length is not deleted from request headers in api-proxy.ts
JWT public paths are narrowed from '/api/v1/content' to specific sub-routes
Cache key in chat_service includes user_tier
Token storage uses localStorage for refresh tokens
verification: Run `find apps/backend -name '*.py' -newer .env.shared -exec python -m py_compile {} \;` to verify Python syntax
Run `cd apps/edge && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -50` to verify TypeScript compiles
findings: All 35 issues implemented successfully. Python syntax verified with py_compile on all modified files. TypeScript verified with tsc --noEmit (zero errors). Edge required npm install for type checking. No pre-existing test failures encountered. The api-proxy.ts getCorsHeaders import was kept because it is still used in error response handlers even though the main response CORS lines were removed.
